title: 2024 HMMT February Guts Problem 11
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a rectangle such that \(A B=20\) and \(A D=24\). Point \(P\) lies inside \(A B C D\) such that triangles \(P A C\) and \(P B D\) have areas 20 and 24, respectively. Compute all possible areas of triangle \(P A B\).

solutions.text:
There are four possible locations of \(P\) as shown in the diagram. Let \(O\) be the center. Then, \([P A O]=10\) and \([P B O]=12\). Thus, \([P A B]=[A O B] \pm[P A O] \pm[P B O]=120 \pm 10 \pm 12\), giving the four values \(98,118,122\), and 142 .
